The Enter counterpart remaps RUN toEnter and menu.context.activate.enter toF9 and likewise emits Chosen(RUN). command() guards only MenuCmd::Activate; binding_response() still handles the item action in its separate dynamic branch without a hidden physical activation guard. Both probes are RED in the complete25-test independent run. Direct unremapped Space item chord and ordinary hidden Enter/Space probes are GREEN because the default built-in Activate binding wins routing.
